idle.name: 待漂
idle.description: 无鱼：轻微随波升沉、左右轻晃，循环。

crucian.name: 鲫鱼
crucian.description: 三次轻点，随后下顿约露出长度三分之一，迅速弹回。

minnow.name: 白条
minnow.description: 急促乱点，小幅高频抖动，中途有一次小顿。

shrimp.name: 青虾
shrimp.description: 连续小送漂，同时缓慢横移；每次顶起很小。

grass_carp.name: 草鱼
grass_carp.description: 没有试口，直接迅速将整支漂拖没。

carp.name: 鲤鱼
carp.description: 缓缓送起半截，顶住停顿，再缓缓送没。

yellow_catfish.name: 黄颡鱼
yellow_catfish.description: 两下清晰有力的顿，间隔严格相等。

perch.name: 鳜鱼
perch.description: 先一记重顿，再压着半露的漂向右拖走。

koi.name: 锦鲤
koi.description: 匀顺优雅地下沉，漂身微微回旋，不送漂、不急顿。

silver_scale.name: 银鳞鱼
silver_scale.description: 先很轻地一抖，随后极快黑漂；和草鱼直接黑漂区分。

starfish.name: 星斑鱼
starfish.description: 静止等待，突然连点三下，停住，再黑漂。

salamander.name: 灵鲵
salamander.description: 始终不下沉，缓慢向远处横漂很远。远距离位移需读取 motion_xy。

golden_carp.name: 金鳞鲤
golden_carp.description: 猛顶送出半截，紧接着急沉，不在高位久停。

turtle.name: 老龟
turtle.description: 前半段完全不动，随后极慢地横挪并一点点下沉。

jade_dragon_carp.name: 玉须龙鲤
jade_dragon_carp.description: 先轻轻画圈，水面起小漩涡，随后猛地拽没。

debris.name: 杂物
debris.description: 草鞋、枯枝、水草：被死重缓慢斜压下去，没有试口、反弹或主动抖动。

playback.line_tip: draw_origin + frames[i].tip_xy; when black_float=true use water_contact
playback.timing: uniform 1000/fps per frame. Only idle and minnow loop; other bite cues play once.
playback.root_motion: motion_xy must be applied for long drifts, especially salamander and perch. Small within-frame movements are already painted into sprites.
playback.black_float: Float body intentionally disappears under water; the expanding painted ripple remains.
playback.registration: Anchor [64,184] is fixed water patch origin; actual moving float/water intersection is contact_xy.
playback.scope: 14 fish cues + idle + debris. Same float artwork and palette in every cue; fish identities are signalled by movement alone.
